notes.title: Bonus Features, Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes: A launch command has been added to directly open the bonus content included with the game!

notes.title: New Ways to Read
notes.notes: Adventures in the Light & Dark is now available as an ebook as well! Visit Protoria's website to grab your copy. We also recently fixed a few bugs in the presentation. Don't forget this package includes a FULL set of bonus features. In your game's local files, you'll find the book's soundtrack and more. Mac OSX version coming soon.

notes.title: Welcome to the Reach
notes.notes:
Don't leave; there's nothing to be afraid of.

There are far more things to look closer at, reader. There are far more things to see and hear.

Far more things north of here.
